saints.name: St. Maurice and the Theban Legion
saints.title: Martyrs
saints.shortBlurb: A legion of Christian soldiers who, led by their commander Maurice, chose death rather than turn their swords against the innocent or deny their faith…
biography: According to ancient tradition, the Theban Legion was a body of Christian soldiers recruited in Egypt and serving under the Emperor Maximian. Ordered, while stationed at Agaunum in the Alps, to take part in the persecution of Christians and to offer pagan sacrifice, they refused under their officer Maurice.

The legion was, it is said, twice decimated and at last put to the sword entire rather than yield. Over their reputed burial place rose the great abbey of Saint-Maurice in the Valais, one of the oldest continuously inhabited monasteries in the West.
saints.knownFor: Their refusal to persecute fellow Christians, sealed by martyrdom.
